options.systemMessage:
You are a real estate lead qualification assistant.
You MUST output ONLY a raw JSON object.
Do NOT include markdown, headers, bullet points, or backticks.
Your entire response must start with { and end with }

Score this Facebook lead ad submission and draft a 
personalized follow-up email.

SCORING RULES:
- Hot: Pre-approved buyer OR seller with a timeline within 
  3 months OR motivated by life event (upsizing, relocating)
- Warm: Active searcher with a budget, but financing is unclear 
  OR 3–6-month timeline
- Cold: Early research, just browsing, no clear timeline 
  or budget

EMAIL TONE BY SCORE:
- Hot: Enthusiastic and action-oriented. Acknowledge their 
  specific situation. Invite them to book a consultation.
- Warm: Friendly and helpful. Offer to answer questions 
  and share relevant listings or market info.
- Cold: Light-touch, zero pressure. Position yourself as 
  a helpful resource for when they are ready.

Format email_body as two parts separated by \n\n:
  Part 1: Greeting line only e.g., "Hi {name},"
  Part 2: Message body 2–3 sentences maximum

OUTPUT — your entire response must be exactly this structure:
{"score":"Hot or Warm or Cold","reasoning":"one sentence","email_subject":"short subject line","email_body":"Hi {name},\n\nBody here."}

parameters.content:
## Facebook Lead Ads to AI-Qualified Follow-Up

When someone submits your Facebook Lead Ad form, this workflow qualifies their intent instantly using AI, sends a personalized follow-up email within seconds, and alerts you immediately for hot leads — before they've even put their phone down.

### How it works
A lead submits your Facebook ad form. Their details arrive via webhook instantly. AI (Gemini) reads their budget, timeline, and situation, then scores them as **Hot**, **Warm**, or **Cold** and drafts a personalized follow-up email tailored to their score. The email sends immediately via Gmail. Every lead logs to Google Sheets with full qualification data and campaign intelligence — so you can see which ads produce the best leads. Hot leads trigger an instant agent notification by email and Slack, so you follow up while the lead is still engaged.

### Requirements
- **Gmail** OAuth2 credential
- **Google Sheets** OAuth2 credential
- **Gemini** API key
- **Google Sheets** — copy the *Facebook Leads Database* sheet template and link it to the Sheets nodes
- **Slack** OAuth2 credential — optional, for Hot lead Slack notifications
- **WhatsApp Business Cloud** credential + Phone Number ID — optional, for WhatsApp follow-up messages

### Setup
1. Connect **Gmail**, **Google Sheets**, and **Gemini API** credentials — all reused from other QualMatic templates.
2. Copy the *Facebook Leads Database* sheet template and link it to the Sheets nodes.
3. Update the agent email address in the "Notify Agent — Hot Lead" node.
4. Choose your trigger (see trigger section below).
5. **Slack is optional** — connect your Slack credential to the Slack node for a second Hot lead alert channel, or leave it disconnected.
6. **WhatsApp is optional** — connect your WhatsApp Business Cloud credential and set your Phone Number ID in the "Send WhatsApp Follow-Up" node.

### Customization
- Edit the AI prompt to adjust scoring criteria or tone.
- Add Warm lead agent notifications by duplicating the Hot lead branch.
- Extend with additional form fields by mapping them in the Extract node.

##  Choose Your Trigger

**Option A — Webhook (active, default)** 
Works immediately with any lead source, Facebook Lead Ads via Zapier or Make, website forms, or landing pages. No Facebook app setup needed.

**Option B — Facebook Lead Ads (disabled)**
Connects directly to Facebook Lead Ads without a forwarder. Requires a permanent public n8n URL and Meta Developer app configuration. Enable this node and disable the Webhook node to use it.

## Extract & Normalize Lead Details
Transforms Facebook's field_data array format into clean, named fields used by all downstream nodes. Also handles flat JSON from direct webhook POST requests. Campaign metadata (Ad ID, Campaign ID) is captured here
for business intelligence logging.

## Qualify & Draft Follow-Up
One Gemini AI call scores the lead as Hot, Warm, or Cold based on budget, timeline, and situation, then drafts a personalized follow-up email tailored to their score.
Hot leads get an action-oriented email.
Warm leads get a friendly, helpful email.
Cold leads get a light-touch, zero-pressure email.
If AI fails, a fallback email still sends automatically.

## Email, Log & Agent Alert
A follow-up email sends immediately if an email address was provided. Every lead logs to Google Sheets with full qualification data and campaign intelligence columns showing which ad and campaign generated the lead.
Hot leads trigger an instant agent notification by email and optionally Slack, so you follow up while the lead is still engaged. WhatsApp follow-up is optional and works when configured.

## Form Field Names Must Match
This node maps Facebook form field names to clean variables.
If you rename any question in your Facebook Lead Ad form,
update the matching field name in this Code node or data
will not extract correctly.
Field names use lowercase with underscores — check the
exact names in your webhook test payload.

## Update Agent Email Address
Replace the placeholder email in this node with the agent's real email address before going live.

## WhatsApp Setup Required Before Using
1. Add your WhatsApp Business Cloud credential in n8n. Settings → Credentials.
2. Replace YOUR_PHONE_NUMBER_ID in the Sender Phone Number field with your actual numeric Phone Number ID from Meta Developer App → WhatsApp → API Setup.
3. Ensure your recipient numbers are added to your WhatsApp test recipient list in Meta Developer App.
4. Connect this node from the Parse AI Output node output once configured.
